meta.title: Dossier 0.7.1
meta.lede: A calmer reply block that says each reply in plain words, and a showcase that opens with a brainstorm about code. Every gate passed, and the call is ship.

parts.markdown: 0.7.1 answers the first reader feedback on 0.7.0: the block at the bottom of a deciding page was loud and did not say that it fills in from the reader's choices. Models from 0.7.0 build unchanged.

parts.title: Changes
rows: The saturated block is now a bordered section that says it fills in as you decide. It shows an example until you do, then your reply with Copy reply and Copy as JSON.
Every reply line is said again in words, such as Choice: Safer changes. Pick: ideas 2 and 10. Go and the reader share the wording and its test cases.
A brainstorm about a booking service's code leads the examples and the README, and the spring fixes show the same kind without code.

Examples on pages with nothing to rule on keep only the choice, the Markdown copy names an empty set of decisions, the last section drops its rule above the block, and code tabs are four columns wide.

items.title: Go checks
items.summary: Formatting, vet, staticcheck, errcheck, the race-enabled tests, and a CGO-free build all passed.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `make check` in `core`, which also drift-checks generated code and the vendored Graphviz.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Every package passed. The reader is 20,257 bytes of its 20,480 byte budget and the stylesheet 29,106 of 30,720.

items.title: Showcase fixtures
items.summary: All seven example documents build with no warnings and match their HTML and Markdown goldens.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `TestExamples` and `TestExampleReplies` build the showcase the way a reader gets it and paste a reply into each decision document.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Seven documents, six kinds, no warnings, and the largest page, the booking service brainstorm, at 110 KB of its 120 KB budget.

items.title: 0.6 imports
items.summary: All 17 legacy fixtures upgrade to models that pass the strict 0.7 checks.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `TestLegacyFixtures` upgrades each 0.6 document and compares it with its golden.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: 17 of 17 upgrade strictly onto their kinds' vocabularies.

items.title: React package tests
items.summary: The wrapper renders through the binary, and the reader writes every shared reply case in the same line and words as Go.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `npm test` in `packages/react`, including the 15 reply cases shared with the Go parser, which now also hold both sides to when nothing is decided.

items.title: Distribution dry run
items.summary: Six archives, their checksums, the Homebrew formula, and seven npm packages build and install.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `make dist-check` cross-compiles every target, runs the formula's test commands on an archive, and installs the npm packages from tarballs.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Every check printed ok, and the binary and the launcher both report 0.7.1.

items.title: Reader and studio in a browser
items.summary: Your reply in every state, in light, dark, and at phone width, and decisions kept by the studio.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: Headless Chrome on the built showcase: the empty and decided block on five pages, the ship warning, Clear, both copy buttons, a reload, search, and the print rules, then `dossier serve` with a second tab.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: All passed. Search never highlights inside the block, and the studio renders stored decisions into it.

parts.markdown: 0.7.1 changes only the page and the showcase, so going back to 0.7.0 is safe for any model.
